sourceClaims.claim: The Basic Elements corpus has 133 source SVGs; Icons.svg contributes 125 exhaustively dispositioned candidates over 302 unique primitives, including two distinct calendar glyphs.
The merged corpus publishes 244 canonical icons and 250 variants while preserving the original 119-icon compatibility subset.
Explicit compatibility aliases preserve historical names without becoming canonical glyphs.
Uncertain source labels remain explicitly uncertain and are not silently merged.

evidence.source-integrity: pass: hash and element-level paint tests cover all 133 Basic Elements SVGs plus every one of the 302 referenced raw Icons.svg primitives; the candidate ledger has no omission or primitive reuse
evidence.structural-contract: pass: tests verify 244 canonical icons, 250 variants, the unchanged 119-icon compatibility subset, 42 explicit aliases, distinct calendars, provenance, sprite symbols, runtime helpers, and package exports
evidence.runtime-browser: pass: the icon catalog resolves all 244 canonical symbols to non-empty painted browser geometry
evidence.accessibility: not-applicable: the icon package supplies geometry and paint but no semantic meaning; accessible names and decorative treatment remain consumer-level claims
evidence.focused-visual: pass: a focused twelve-icon snapshot covers original/new, currentColor, preserved-paint, collision, state-family, file-type, uncertain, and both-calendar topologies
evidence.consumer-integration: pass: Showcase exposes a direct searchable #icons destination and plain HTML consumes both calendars plus a preserved-paint sheet icon through published assets
evidence.responsive-content-stress: not-applicable: intrinsic icon geometry is viewport-independent

limitations: Consumer-specific accessible names remain the consumer contract.
Most recovered Icons.svg semantic labels have medium confidence and remain identified by source IDs and confidence metadata.
